metadata.title: How Stale Is Too Stale? Bounding Consecutive Information Outages in V2X Collision Warning — Reproduction Package

creators.name: Liu, Xixin
creators.affiliation: International School, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

metadata.description: Simulation kernel, per-seed CSV outputs, figure-generation scripts, and one-command reproducibility package (reproduce.sh) for the IEEE Access submission on an information-freshness contract for V2X collision warnings. ~16,200 controlled simulation runs; V* sensitivity table; Gilbert-Elliot burst validation of the C2 blind-run-tail contract.
